sources: https://github.com/Definedge-Securities/pyintegrate (official Definedge client, MIT): integrate/connect.py, data.py, orders.py
https://github.com/Definedge-Securities/pyintegrate/tree/main/tests/mock_responses (login_step_1/2, quotes, orders, trades, positions, holdings, limits, place/modify/cancel_order, historical.csv)
notes: Payloads are Definedge's own mock responses from pyintegrate's test suite, re-keyed to NIFTY/SENSEX October 2026 contracts. Masters are served as plain CSV text (the adapter accepts a ZIP or a CSV body; the ZIP path is unit-tested separately). Session fields are added per fixture so manifest.creds stays logged out. Every token, id and name is a dummy.
